checks.criterion: Independent HTTP observations prove each selected Gherkin scenario against a fresh candidate copy.
checks.failure: A scenario is contradicted, missing, or cannot be observed.

checks.criterion: The grader records the refusal and leaves the blind judgment pending.
checks.failure: The grader judges the refusal from its own context or omits the handoff.

checks.criterion: A fresh judge names an actionable request from only the refusal; a fresh app confirms that exact request.
checks.failure: The answer needs hidden context or its exact request is not confirmed over HTTP.

checks.criterion: The public form confirms a free slot and displays the persistent holding and all three derived views; trace and screenshots are attached.
checks.failure: The UI cannot complete the journey or disagrees with the persisted booking.

checks.criterion: One hundred fresh overlapping two-household races each produce exactly one confirmation and one held refusal; derived views name one holder.
checks.failure: Any race confirms twice, refuses twice, or leaves inconsistent views.

checks.criterion: A bounded real booking emits candidate-bound spans and metrics tied to the confirmed record.
checks.failure: The probe cannot associate the observed telemetry with the candidate and booking request.
